cards.complexityReason: SUBMIT mode changes workflow state, creates a WorkflowTask, writes an OutboxMessage, and commits multiple aggregates (Ask, AskVersion, WorkflowInstance, WorkflowTask, WorkflowDecision, WorkflowHistory, OutboxMessage, comment, audit, attachment links) atomically in one transaction.

differences.item: HTTP status code for business rule violations
differences.specValue: 422 for fteAmount > headCountAmount, date ordering, and date-in-past violations (AC5, AC7, Error Behaviour section)
differences.masterLldValue: 400 validation_failed for all invalid request conditions (MLLD 12.2); 422 is not in the approved error table

differences.specValue: SUBMIT by a leadership-group member routes directly to status 145 DPP Ops Review, bypassing PPL Review (FR5, BR25, AC3)
differences.masterLldValue: Master LLD 7.4 notes the shortcut exists but defers to 'verified source rules'; the exact permission or group definition is not confirmed in the Master LLD

differences.item: Workflow status values expressed as numeric IDs
differences.specValue: 123 (In Progress / Save & Exit), 127 (PPL Review), 145 (DPP Ops Review)
differences.masterLldValue: Master LLD uses named states only (Draft/In Progress, PPL Review, DPP Ops Review); numeric-to-name mapping is not present in the Master LLD or state-transition document

missingFacts.item: Exact permission code that grants 'Create New ASK' access and the RBAC matrix row for this operation
Definition of 'leadership group' membership: which role(s), group(s) or permission flag the API must check to determine the SUBMIT routing path
Reference data IDs for the 'first option' of needReasonId (BR6) and generalSpecialityNeedId (BR7) that trigger field-clearing behaviour
Reference data ID or value for 'retirement' needReasonId that makes endDate optional (BR11)
Enumerated set of levelNeedId values constituting the 'top-3 set' that makes rolePostingId required (BR17)
Confirmed success HTTP status code: 200 or 201 for a successful create operation

Confirmed transaction scope: whether Ask, AskVersion, WorkflowInstance, WorkflowTask, WorkflowDecision, WorkflowHistory, OutboxMessage, comment, audit, and attachment links must all commit atomically or whether any are deferred

Clarification of 'new-version only' qualifier on pml (BR9), titlingCategory (BR18), and transitionalCoach (BR19): whether these fields are in scope for the initial create operation or reserved for amend
Resolution of duplicate 'numberofresources' field in the request schema (noted in spec Assumptions item 12): confirmed single field definition and its validation rules
Approved OpenAPI operation and schema components (CreateCoreAskRequest, CreateCoreAskResponse) for this endpoint

assumptions: buttonValue=Exit is a no-op: the API returns a success response without persisting any data (confirmed in spec Assumptions item 2).
Attachment file-upload contract is represented as a file-upload array in the request body (confirmed in spec Assumptions item 3).
All write operations (ASK record, task, comment, audit, attachments) are assumed to commit atomically; this is unconfirmed and recorded as a missing fact for Solution Architecture.
Leadership group membership is derived server-side from the authenticated caller's current DRT roles and is never accepted from the request body (SEC 003).
The path /core-asks in the specification differs from the Master LLD catalogue path /api/v1/asks; the specification path is recorded as a difference pending Solution Architecture confirmation.
